title: Delhi
description: Stone, water, and the geometry of Delhi’s historic spaces, seen through the shifting light of the day.

photos.title: Pool reflection
photos.caption: Delhi · Colour
photos.description: The red sandstone tomb appears upside down in the pool, its arches and palms softened by ripples across the foreground water.
photos.alt: The red sandstone tomb appears upside down in the pool, its arches and palms softened by ripples across the foreground water.

photos.title: Red symmetry
photos.caption: Delhi · Colour
photos.description: Humayun’s Tomb stands square to the camera, its red arches set against a sky and a narrow strip of green lawn.
photos.alt: Humayun’s Tomb stands square to the camera, its red arches set against a sky and a narrow strip of green lawn.

photos.title: Shaded gateway
photos.caption: Delhi · Black & White
photos.description: In monochrome, the garden gate frames a smaller arch beyond it; branches and deep shade enclose the path to the tomb.
photos.alt: In monochrome, the garden gate frames a smaller arch beyond it; branches and deep shade enclose the path to the tomb.

photos.title: Inverted arches
photos.caption: Delhi · Colour
photos.description: A pool reflects the sandstone arches upside down, its still waterline cutting the building cleanly across the middle of the frame.
photos.alt: A pool reflects the sandstone arches upside down, its still waterline cutting the building cleanly across the middle of the frame.

photos.title: Courtyard visitors
photos.caption: Delhi · Black & White
photos.description: People cross the open path before the red tomb’s central gateway, their small silhouettes bringing scale to the heavy stone entrance.
photos.alt: People cross the open path before the red tomb’s central gateway, their small silhouettes bringing scale to the heavy stone entrance.

photos.title: Garden geometry
photos.caption: Delhi · Colour
photos.description: Humayun’s Tomb rests beyond a broad green lawn, with palms and a spreading shade tree breaking the building’s long red façade.
photos.alt: Humayun’s Tomb rests beyond a broad green lawn, with palms and a spreading shade tree breaking the building’s long red façade.

photos.title: Passing blur
photos.caption: Delhi · Black & White
photos.description: A moving figure crosses the shadowed foreground while the bright tomb remains sharp beyond the gate, setting motion against still stone.
photos.alt: A moving figure crosses the shadowed foreground while the bright tomb remains sharp beyond the gate, setting motion against still stone.

photos.title: Palm façade
photos.caption: Delhi · Colour
photos.description: A palm and leafy tree partly screen Humayun’s Tomb, its dome and long red façade set beneath a clear pastel sky.
photos.alt: A palm and leafy tree partly screen Humayun’s Tomb, its dome and long red façade set beneath a clear pastel sky.

photos.title: Threshold passerby
photos.caption: Delhi · Black & White
photos.description: A blurred visitor passes through the arch while the pale tomb beyond remains visible, the doorway dividing shadow from open light.
photos.alt: A blurred visitor passes through the arch while the pale tomb beyond remains visible, the doorway dividing shadow from open light.

photos.title: Red façade
photos.caption: Delhi · Colour
photos.description: Humayun’s Tomb stands beyond the lawn, its red sandstone arches balanced by palms and a clear sky in the frontal view.
photos.alt: Humayun’s Tomb stands beyond the lawn, its red sandstone arches balanced by palms and a clear sky in the frontal view.

photos.title: Blurred threshold
photos.caption: Delhi · Black & White
photos.description: A blurred visitor crosses the shadowed archway while the bright tomb appears beyond, its central doorway aligned with the garden path.
photos.alt: A blurred visitor crosses the shadowed archway while the bright tomb appears beyond, its central doorway aligned with the garden path.

photos.title: Garden arch
photos.caption: Delhi · Colour
photos.description: Humayun’s Tomb stands between tall palms, visitors crossing the broad lawn below its red arches under a pale blue evening sky.
photos.alt: Humayun’s Tomb stands between tall palms, visitors crossing the broad lawn below its red arches under a pale blue evening sky.

photos.title: Tomb passerby

photos.title: Puddle mirror
photos.caption: Delhi · Colour
photos.description: A red sandstone façade and palms appear upside down in rainwater, their reflected lines softened by ripples across the lower frame.

photos.title: Garden visitors

photos.description: Several visitors gather in the garden before the tomb, their dark forms crossing the bright lawn and framing the central entrance.
photos.alt: Several visitors gather in the garden before the tomb, their dark forms crossing the bright lawn and framing the central entrance.

photos.alt: Qutub Minar rises between dark trees in monochrome, its carved stone bands and narrow balconies sharply defined against the open sky above.

photos.alt: Two men pause among the old stone walls beneath Qutub Minar, their white garments bright against the dark carved surfaces.

photos.title: Central reflection
photos.caption: Delhi · Colour
photos.description: The central walkway leads toward Humayun’s Tomb while the still pool repeats its arches and trees beneath the bright sky.
